say:4:1321750002:0.text: What's going on? Is there something wrong with these capybaras?
say:4:1321750002:0.source_cn: 怎么了？这些水豚有问题吗？

say:5:1321750003:0.text: The Archduke gifted these capybaras to Her Highness after she fell ill...
say:5:1321750003:0.source_cn: 这几只水豚，是大公阁下在公主殿下生病后，特意送来陪伴殿...

say:6:1321750004:0.text: When Her Highness was dying, she worried that they would make the Archduke sad, so she instructed me to send them to a reliable caretaker to ensure their comfort.
say:6:1321750004:0.source_cn: 公主殿下临终时，担心这些水豚会让大公阁下触景生情，所以...

say:7:1321750005:0.text: I believe I sent them away long ago, but now they're here. They seem very close to the people in the castle.
say:7:1321750005:0.source_cn: 我早就已经将它们送走了……可现在它们就在这里，而且看起...

say:8:1321750006:0.text: The past is reappearing again, just like when we saw Valka and Cryonaia fighting each other on the ancient battlefield. It could be one of those weird vision thingies of the past.
say:8:1321750006:0.source_cn: 简直是往日重现……像之前我们在古战场上见到瓦丽卡和冰之...

say:9:1321750007:0.text: But what happened here is completely different from what happened in reality...
say:9:1321750007:0.source_cn: 可是……这里和现实中发生的事完全不一样！

say:10:1321750008:0.text: The castle festivities were unprepared when Her Highness was alive, so this can't be the past.
say:10:1321750008:0.source_cn: 公主殿下在世的时候，城堡庆典根本没有准备好！这不可能是...
say:10:1321750008:0.male: The castle festivities were unprepared when Her Highness was alive, so this can't be the past.
say:10:1321750008:0.female: The castle festivities were unprepared when Her Highness was alive, so this can't be the past.

say:14:1321750009:0.text: That's right. Since you know this is an illusion, there is no need to care whether it's real or not.
say:14:1321750009:0.source_cn: 没错。既然知道这里是幻境，就没必要在意它是否真实。
say:14:1321750009:0.male: That's right. Since you know this is an illusion, there is no need to care whether it's real or not.
say:14:1321750009:0.female: That's right. Since you know this is an illusion, there is no need to care whether it's real or not.

say:15:1321750010:0.text: Compelling humans with beautiful illusions is precisely one of the favored tactics of the Hypogeans. As champions of Dura, we must not fall for this trick.
say:15:1321750010:0.source_cn: 以虚幻的美好蛊惑人类，正是恶魔的手段。我等身为艾雅的子...

say:16:1321750011:0.text: This illusion is different from what we have experienced before. In the previous illusion, we witnessed the true reason for the princess' illness and even her death.
say:16:1321750011:0.source_cn: 所以说……这次的幻境和我们之前经历的不一样。之前的幻境...

say:17:1321750012:0.text: But in this illusion... Princess Yolena didn't die. The festivities are being held, and she's having a great time.
say:17:1321750012:0.source_cn: 但在这次的幻境里，没能举办的庆典成功举办了。亚莲娜公主...

say:21:1321750015:0.text: Could it be that everyone's unwilling to accept Princess Yolena's death, so they all secretly wish for an alternative version of events...?
say:21:1321750015:0.source_cn: 难道是大家不愿接受亚莲娜公主的死，众人的心愿又构成了一...

say:23:1321750016:0.text: But we didn't see any weird-looking maids this time, and talking to them didn't teleport us back to reality...
say:23:1321750016:0.source_cn: 可我们这次没见到像上次那样，长相很奇特的侍女。和他们说...

say:24:1321750017:0.text: Maybe we haven't met the right ones yet. The castle is pretty big, after all.
say:24:1321750017:0.source_cn: 或许只是我们还没碰到？毕竟城堡这么大呢。

say:25:1321750018:0.text: Let's continue with the festivities for now. I'm sure there will be clues as we continue forward.
say:25:1321750018:0.source_cn: 先继续参加庆典吧，我相信一定会有线索。

say:30:1321750014:0.text: The after-effects of the Hypogean linger everywhere in this castle... Every maid and guard has more or less been affected.
say:30:1321750014:0.source_cn: 这座城堡里，到处都残留着恶魔的气息……每个侍女和侍卫的...
say:30:1321750014:0.male: The after-effects of the Hypogean linger everywhere in this castle... Every maid and guard has more or less been affected.
say:30:1321750014:0.female: The after-effects of the Hypogean linger everywhere in this castle... Every maid and guard has more or less been affected.

choice:11:1:2.text: Maybe this is someone else's dream.
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 这或许又是谁的执念吧
